privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introText1: Welcome to Food AI. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal information when you use our service. Food AI is an academic project developed as part of the 42 school curriculum. By using this application, you agree to the practices described in this policy.
privacy.collectIntro: We collect the following types of data when you use Food AI:
privacy.collectAccount: Account information: Your username and email address, provided at registration.
privacy.collectAuth: Authentication data: Your password, which is stored exclusively as a salted cryptographic hash (bcrypt/PBKDF2). We never store your password in plain text.
privacy.collectImages: Images you upload: Food photos you submit to the application for analysis and generation. These images are stored on our server and linked to your account.
privacy.collectGenerated: Generated images: The AI-generated versions of your food photos, stored as URLs referencing the generation service.
privacy.collectUsage: Usage data: Metadata about your generations, including timestamps, processing status, and AI analysis results.
privacy.useIntro: Your data is used exclusively to operate the Food AI service:
privacy.useAnalysis: Image analysis: Uploaded images are sent to an object detection model (RT-DETR) to verify they contain food, and then to a vision AI model (Gemini) to extract visual details.
privacy.useGeneration: Image generation: Analysis results are used to build a prompt and generate an enhanced food photo via a generative AI model (Flux).
privacy.useHistory: History and personalization: We store your past generations so you can review them in the History page.
privacy.useAuth: Authentication: Your credentials are used solely to identify you and protect your data from unauthorized access.
privacy.useNoSell: We do not sell, rent, or share your personal data with third parties for marketing purposes. Images are transmitted to third-party AI providers (Replicate API) only for processing purposes and in accordance with their own privacy policies.
privacy.retentionIntro: Your data is retained for as long as your account is active. Specifically:
privacy.retentionAccount: Account data (username, email, hashed password) is kept until you request account deletion.
privacy.retentionImages: Uploaded and generated images are stored indefinitely unless you delete individual generations or your account.
privacy.retentionResults: AI analysis results (text descriptions of your food images) are stored as part of each generation record.
privacy.rightsIntro: You have the following rights regarding your personal data:
privacy.rightsAccess: Access: You may view all data associated with your account by using the application (History page shows all your generations).
privacy.rightsDeletion: Deletion: You may request deletion of your account and all associated data by contacting us at the address below. Individual generations can be deleted from the History page.
privacy.rightsCorrection: Correction: You may update your account information through your profile settings.
privacy.rightsPortability: Data portability: You may request an export of your data in a readable format by contacting us.
privacy.securityIntro: We implement standard security practices to protect your data:
privacy.securityTls: All connections use HTTPS with TLS encryption.
privacy.securityHash: Passwords are hashed using Django's built-in PBKDF2 algorithm with a salt.
privacy.securityDb: The database is not exposed to the public internet.
privacy.securityCookies: Authentication is verified via secure session cookies on all protected endpoints.
privacy.securityAcademic: As this is an academic project, it uses a self-signed SSL certificate. While we make every effort to protect your data, we cannot guarantee absolute security.
privacy.thirdPartyIntro: Food AI uses the following third-party services for AI processing:
privacy.thirdPartyReplicate: Replicate API — used to run the Gemini vision model and the Flux image generation model. Images are transmitted to their servers for processing. See Replicate's Privacy Policy.
privacy.cookiesText1: Food AI uses httpOnly session cookies to keep you signed in. When you log in, the server establishes a secure session stored in a cookie on your device. These cookies are automatically cleared when you log out and expire when your session ends.
privacy.cookiesText2: To protect against cross-site request forgery (CSRF), the application also uses a cross-site request forgery token cookie alongside the session. We do not use tracking cookies or third-party analytics.
privacy.contactText: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or wish to exercise your data rights, please contact the development team through the 42 school project platform or open an issue in the project repository.
privacy.changesText: We may update this Privacy Policy as the project evolves. Any significant changes will be reflected in the "Last updated" date at the top of this page. Continued use of the application after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
